input.body: ## Precondition - Turn ON Auto Correction on Keyboard Setting - Turn OFF Predictive Text on Keyboard Setting ## Step to Reproduce 1. Create a new thought 2. Type `Makre` 3. Tap Space to auto correct `Makre` into `Make` 4. Create new thought again 5. Swipe left with 3 finger to undo Step 4; creating new thought 6. Swipe left with 3 finger to undo Step 3; auto correct implementation 7. Swipe left with 3 finger to undo Step 2; to delete the thought entirely ## Current behavior Nothing to undo alert is shown on Step 7. Note: This is not reproducible when undoing using Undo button on Toolbar ## Expected behavior Alert should not be shown. The thought should be deleted by the Undo on Step 7. _Originally posted by @BayuAri in https://github.com/cybersemics/em/pull/4692#pullrequestreview-4874957952_
input.title: `Nothing to Undo` alert is prompted after undoing the auto correct
